metricSemanticsNotes: Countries are the grouping unit: no country appears in both train and test of a fold.
k=5 folds per repeat, 20 seeded repeats, 100 total evaluations.
R² is computed per fold on that fold’s test rows; a fold contributes to the R² distribution only where the statistic is defined.
Distributions are reported instead of a single point estimate because the repeats are independent shuffles.
Supersedes cv_country_out.json for inference: country-out holds out 1-4 rows per fold, below the three-pair floor for R² (KI-14).
